description: This file defines the FatalErrorHandler class, which implements error handling logic for fatal exceptions within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for detecting unexpected exceptions, logging fatal errors, and terminating the process on fatal conditions.

classes.name: FatalErrorHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling fatal errors in Orleans runtime, logging them, and terminating the process.

methods.name: IsUnexpected
methods.description: Determines if an exception is considered unexpected, excluding ThreadAbortException.

methods.name: OnFatalException
methods.description: Handles a fatal exception by logging it, printing a message, pausing briefly, breaking into debugger if attached, and terminating the process.
